stories.title: White Sox Sweep Tigers at Comerica — AL Central Lead Reaches Season-Best 4.5 Games

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: White Sox 4, Tigers 3. Series sweep at Comerica. AL Central lead: season-best 4.5 games. Benintendi go-ahead single in the seventh. Chicago is 22-13 against AL Central opponents. This division has a new boss. #WhiteSox #GoGo #ALCentral

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: White Sox are 64-58. Season-best 4.5 game lead in the AL Central. 5-3 on the season vs. Detroit. 5 wins in their last 7. From 41-121 in 2024 to AL Central leaders in 2026. The turnaround is real. #WhiteSox #GoGo

stories.title: Alvarez Snaps 13-Game HR Drought — Triple Crown Chase Back in Play

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Yordan Alvarez hit HR No. 36 off George Kirby on Saturday. It was the first homer Kirby had EVER allowed to an Astros hitter — across 12 starts and 255 plate appearances. 13-game drought over. Triple Crown chase back on. #Astros #YordanAlvarez

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Yordan Alvarez: .323 BA. 36 HR. 88 RBI. He's now a legitimate Triple Crown contender — something no player has done since Miguel Cabrera in 2012. The August drought is over. The story is back. #Astros #YordanAlvarez #TripleCrown
